title: Deliver the Ghost Ship map as a browser-safe JPEG

phases.title: Use the release-generated JPEG and verify actual browser decoding
Force existing 0.3.3 managed scenes onto the new JPEG asset
Publish the JPEG delivery repair as module 0.3.4

finalChecks.name: Manifest version and cover
finalChecks.run: node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('module.json','utf8')); if(m.version!=='0.3.4') throw new Error('expected module 0.3.4'); if(!m.media?.[0]?.url?.endsWith('signatory-ghost-ship.jpg')) throw new Error('expected JPEG cover');"
